comment: Twenty-two of the forty-one parameters have no widget on the panel: the sequencer rate, the base pitch, the twelve note tunings and eight parameters that exist only to carry context-menu links. They are reachable from the right-click menu and are covered by menu lines rather than control lines. The module declares no inputs and no outputs; everything reaches the rest of the suite through the g_module and g_timeline globals in Tracker.cpp. The manual calls the pattern-view columns note columns and cv columns, which is what the lines here follow.
